newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber prices slip in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber prices slip in technical correction.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday, pressured by profit taking amid a technical correction, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen to 3.2 yen per kg lower. Benchmark July was down 1.6 at 156.0 yen.
The market started the session on a weaker tone, as bearish sentiment carried over from the previous day.

Activity was lacklustre. "Given the easier overseas markets reflecting weak demand, perceptions are spreading in the market that the upside potential in Tokyo will be limited," one trader said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
